channel.title: Ether-MOSH News + Updates
channel.description: Satirical, sourced effect and mode education with practical production guides from Ether-MOSH.

item.title: Your Pattern Doesn't Tile—Stop Gaslighting the Seam
item.description: Learn how Ether-MOSH Pattern mode, labeled Motif and Motif Maestro, builds seamless tiles and repeat proofs from Forge, uploaded images, or camera stills.

item.title: Forge Mode Already Started the Fight
item.description: Learn how Ether-MOSH Forge Mode combines six seeded procedural generators, effect stacks, crossfades, audio response, seamless controls, and print-ready exports.

item.title: Your Fake CRT Looks Cheap—Stop at the Scanlines
item.description: Learn how CRT displays form images and how to use Ether-MOSH CRT Curvature, Shadow Mask, and Bloom for live visuals, motion design, installations, and print.

item.title: Break the Keyframes Before Lunch
item.description: Learn how datamoshing uses video-compression logic and how to control Ether-MOSH Datamosh for loops, live visuals, music videos, projections, and print stills.

item.title: Sort Your Pixels Before They Sort You
item.description: Pixel sorting history, live controls, practical recipes, and applications beyond the browser.

item.title: Halftone Is Not a Phase, Mom—Put These Dots Everywhere
item.description: Halftone print history and practical settings for print, patterns, and projection.

item.title: Make Moire Before Moire Makes You Sick
item.description: Optical interference explained for artists, performers, educators, and people with problematic projectors.
